aggregate_contact_review.scope: Actual exported appliance: every installed wiring body against selected above-core equipment, fixed front interfaces and termination bodies, all six enclosure pieces, two top core caps, funnel frame and electronics roof panel. Current source-defined nominal retaining strips are separate supplemental targets. Both B-fill fittings are tested against every wiring body. The external compressor jacket also clears the physical foam shell. No wire-to-wire packing, physical fit, electrical or energization qualification.

own_attached_lead_service_relationships.scope: Native diagnostic with the attached wire held fixed and its own housing moving. Flexible co-motion, dressing and handling are unqualified. This is not a static installed-equipment contact or a housing-motion clearance result.
